blurb: Device pairing with Mac or PC via USB requires explicit user trust confirmation on the iOS or iPadOS device, after which a 2048-bit RSA pairing record is exchanged and stored. This record enables the host to initiate backup, sync, and diagnostic connections. Accessories connecting via Lightning or USB-C have restricted data access until the device has been unlocked at least once. USB Restricted Mode limits USB accessory communication with the device if it has been more than an hour since the device was last unlocked, protecting against forensic tools and exploit devices connected to a locked iPhone.
